caption: The drawing displays three views of the same women's bonnet, arranged with one view on the left and two smaller, angled views on the right. Each view depicts a bonnet made primarily of black material, likely silk, featuring a large, ruffled brim adorned with intricate black lace. The brim is lined with a row of pink ribbon or fabric that adds a contrasting accent to the otherwise dark palette. Large black bows decorate the sides where long, wide black ribbons hang down, designed to tie under the chin. The right middle and bottom images include side perspectives showing the rounded crown of the bonnet, additional details of black ruffles, and pink embellishments carried through the design. The drawing is done with attention to fabric texture, shading, and highlights, capturing the sheen of the black fabric and the subtle folds and curves of the bonnet’s structure, with the main colors being black, pink, and hints of white for highlights and lace detail, all set against a plain, light background.
title: Elderly Lady's Bonnet
